description: Source code for the TranslatorVulkan class, part of ANGLE project, implementing GLSL to Vulkan shader translation, including shader modifications, uniform handling, and shader-specific transformations.

classes.name: DeclareStructTypesTraverser
classes.description: Traverses shader nodes to find and declare struct types, removing their declarations from the AST.

classes.name: DeclareDefaultUniformsTraverser
classes.description: Traverses shader nodes to declare default uniforms and remove their declarations from the AST.

classes.name: TranslatorVulkan
classes.description: Implements GLSL to Vulkan shader translation, handling shader-specific modifications, uniform management, and output generation.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Main method to translate shader AST into Vulkan GLSL, including preprocessing, uniform handling, and shader modifications.

methods.name: translateImpl
methods.description: Performs the core translation logic, including shader-specific transformations and AST modifications.

methods.name: shouldFlattenPragmaStdglInvariantAll
methods.description: Indicates whether to flatten stdgl invariant pragmas; returns false.

methods.name: getDriverUniformNegViewportYScaleRef
methods.description: Returns a reference to the driver uniform for negated viewport Y scale.

methods.name: getDriverUniformDepthRangeReservedFieldRef
methods.description: Returns a reference to the depth range reserved field within driver uniforms.
